This app's program contains clean-ui-editor's augmentation of
CuiMessageNamespaces. Declaration merging is whole-program, so if that
augmentation shared a program with clean-ui's `messages.ts` SOURCE, the
`defaultMessages` literal in it would stop satisfying its own `CuiMessages`
annotation — the augmented interface requires a namespace the library cannot
itself provide. Resolving clean-ui to its built .d.ts is what a real
satellite package does, and is the arrangement the seam was designed around;
see the note at the top of packages/clean-ui/src/messages.test-d.ts.
Consequence: a typecheck here still reads clean-ui's last build, so it can
lag library source the way apps/docs used to. Tracked in #107.
